completion_only_loss.doc: Deprecated alias for ``assistant_only_loss``; if explicitly set, it overrides.
completion_only_loss.help: Deprecated alias for `assistant_only_loss`. If set, it overrides `assistant_only_loss`.

dataset_text_field.doc: Field name read by the SFT-style tokenization fallback when the dataset is plain text. Default ``"text"``.
dataset_text_field.help: Name of the text field used when tokenizing raw text datasets.

disable_dropout.help: Put both student and teacher states in eval mode before training.

generation_batch_size.help: TRL on-policy generation batch size. Not used by EasyDeL offline distillation.

hidden_state_layers.doc: Tuple of layer indices to match in the hidden-state term. Negative indices follow Python convention. ``None`` matches the last layer only.
hidden_state_layers.help: Indices of transformer layers whose hidden states should be distilled. Negative indices follow Python semantics. Defaults to the final layer when omitted.

hidden_state_loss.doc: Distance function for hidden-state matching. Currently only ``"mse"``.
hidden_state_loss.help: Distance function used for hidden-state distillation. Currently only 'mse' is supported.

hidden_state_loss_weight.doc: Coefficient on the hidden-state matching term. ``None`` (or non-positive) disables that term.
hidden_state_loss_weight.help: Optional coefficient for matching student and teacher hidden states. Set to `None` to disable hidden-state distillation; `0` is accepted for backward compatibility.

lmbda.help: TRL on-policy sampling probability. EasyDeL offline distillation requires 0.0.

logits_chunk_size.doc: When set, computes the KL term in sequence-axis chunks of this size instead of materialising the full ``[B, L, V]`` student logits tensor at once. Trades a small amount of extra compute (LM head recomputed per chunk in the backward pass) for an ``O(L)`` -> ``O(chunk)`` peak memory reduction. Recommended values 128-512 for large vocabularies; ``None`` disables chunking.
logits_chunk_size.help: When > 0, compute the KL-divergence distillation loss in chunks of this many tokens instead of materialising the full [B, L, V] logits tensor. This trades a small amount of extra compute (lm_head is recomputed per chunk during backward) for a massive memory saving — peak logit memory drops from O(B*L*V) to O(B*chunk_size*V). Recommended values: 128-512 for large vocabs. Set to `None` to disable chunking; `0` is accepted for backward compatibility.

loss_add_tail.help: When using `loss_top_k`, add one bucket for all non-top-k teacher/student probability mass.

loss_group_dataset_map.help: With `loss_group_weights`: entry i is the loss group of dataset id i (-1 = no group); None maps dataset i to group i. A supervised token without a group is refused.

loss_group_max_multiplier.help: With `loss_group_weights`: cap on a group's per-token multiplier w_g * N / N_g (None = no cap).

loss_group_weights.help: Per-group loss weights: optimise sum_g w_g * mean_g (each group's supervised-token mean KL) instead of the pooled token mean. Each supervised token of group g is scaled by w_g * N / N_g on the step batch; groups absent from a step drop out and the rest renormalise. Groups come from the per-token `dataset_ids` (else per-row `_dataset_id`) through `loss_group_dataset_map`. Normalised to sum 1.

loss_top_k.help: If positive, distill only the teacher top-k vocabulary support.

max_completion_length.help: TRL on-policy completion length budget. Not used by EasyDeL offline distillation.

max_prompt_length.help: TRL on-policy prompt length budget. EasyDeL offline distillation uses `max_length`.

mtp_distillation.help: Enable Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP) knowledge distillation. When the student has an MTP head (e.g. Qwen3.5 with `mtp_num_hidden_layers > 0` and `mtp_loss_coef > 0`), adds a soft-KD term that supervises the student's MTP head (predicting token t+2) with the teacher's own next-token distribution at position t+1 — the same conditional P(x_{t+2} | x_<=t+1). The teacher needs NO MTP head; its ordinary logits are reused. The student's self-supervised MTP CE (folded into `aux_loss` via `mtp_loss_coef`) is always included on top. Incompatible with `logits_chunk_size`.

mtp_draft_tokens.help: Number of tokens to draft ahead and distill through the MTP head (requires `mtp_distillation=True`). With 1 (default) the depth-1 head is distilled on its single t+2 prediction. With K>1 the head is recursively applied K times (teacher-forced, FastMTP-style) and each step k is distilled against the teacher's next-token distribution at offset k — training the head to draft K tokens ahead, matching how the inference drafter (`num_draft_tokens=K`) recursively re-applies it. Costs K large-vocab projections per step, so keep it modest (e.g. 4-8).

mtp_kd_weight.help: Weight on the soft MTP-KD term added to the total loss when `mtp_distillation=True`. Analogous to the model's `mtp_loss_coef` (which weights the self-supervised MTP CE).

num_generations.help: TRL on-policy generations per prompt. EasyDeL offline distillation requires 1.

reverse_kl_top_1_mode.help: TRL reverse-KL support selector. Only the default is accepted in EasyDeL offline mode.

teacher_cache_add_tail.help: With `teacher_from_cache`: True trains the tail-bucket form (top-k ids get the full-KL gradient, the remaining mass is one bucket); False renormalises both distributions over the k support.

teacher_cache_path.help: With `teacher_from_cache`: the cache root (local or gs://) holding MANIFEST.json.

teacher_cache_segment_align.help: With `teacher_from_cache`: the document-start alignment the cache was dumped with (the manifest's `segment_align` must equal it); also the alignment used when the trainer derives the layout sidecar of a packed batch from its `segment_ids`.

teacher_cache_topk.help: With `teacher_from_cache`: use only the first k cached ids (the tail is re-derived from the kept log-probs). 0 = the cache's own k and stored tail.

teacher_from_cache.help: Offline teacher: the step runs NO teacher forward. Each batch is joined (by row content) with records of an offline teacher cache (`easydel.data.teacher_cache`), adding `teacher_topk_idx` [B,S,k] / `teacher_topk_logp` [B,S,k] / `teacher_tail_logp` [B,S], and the chunked KL becomes the cached top-k + tail KL. Requires `teacher_cache_path`, `logits_chunk_size > 0`, `temperature == 1.0` (the cache stores T=1 log-probs), and no objective that needs the teacher's full distribution or hidden states (beta / cakld_gamma / loss_top_k / MTP / hidden / attention). `teacher_model=None` is accepted only in this mode. A batch without a cache record raises.

teacher_matched_compilation.help: Run the teacher forward as a jax.vjp primal so it compiles with the same structure as the student's differentiated forward, removing the bf16 grad-vs-nograd KL floor (~0.5 nats at 60 layers; identical weights then match bitwise). Costly at long context: custom-VJP kernels take their train cores, whose fused Pallas kernels always materialize backward residuals (not DCE-able), which can spill HBM and slow steps by an order of magnitude at 131k tokens. Enable only when the exact KL reading is worth it or at scales where the residuals fit.

teacher_model_revision.help: Reserved teacher revision metadata for externally loaded teacher modules.

temperature.doc: Softmax temperature applied to both student and teacher logits before computing the KL term. Larger values (3-10) reveal more of the teacher's relative confidence ordering. Default ``2.0``.
temperature.help: Temperature for softening probability distributions. Higher values create softer distributions, revealing more about teacher's confidence.

top_k.help: TRL on-policy top-k sampling. Not used by EasyDeL offline distillation.

top_p.help: TRL on-policy top-p sampling. Not used by EasyDeL offline distillation.

trainer_prefix.help: Prefix used for trainer logs, checkpoints, and wandb runs.

filter_by_efficiency.help: Whether to include reward-per-token efficiency in filter scoring. Higher reward-per-token responses are preferred when enabled.

num_remains_in_group.help: Number of samples to retain after filtering per group. Must be >= 2 and < num_generations if specified. If None, no filtering is applied (behaves like GRPO).

beta.help: Interpolation factor in the generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence. 0.0 reduces to forward KL(teacher‖student) while 1.0 becomes reverse KL(student‖teacher).

disable_dropout.doc: When ``True``, dropout is disabled on both student and teacher for deterministic distillation targets.
disable_dropout.help: Disable dropout in both student and teacher models for more stable distillation.

lmbda.doc: Probability of replacing the supervised batch with on-policy student samples. ``None`` (or ``0``) disables on-policy sampling. Validated in ``[0, 1]``. Default ``0.5``.
lmbda.help: Probability of performing on-policy student generation for a batch. Set to `None` to disable on-policy sampling; `0` is accepted for backward compatibility.

max_new_tokens.doc: Maximum number of tokens generated per prompt during on-policy rollouts. Default ``128``.
max_new_tokens.help: Maximum number of tokens to generate during on-policy rollouts.

seq_kd.doc: When ``True``, the batch is always regenerated by the teacher before any student-side processing (sequence-level KD). Stacks with ``lmbda`` for hybrid schedules.
seq_kd.help: Enable sequence-level KD by always regenerating the batch with the teacher before training.

temperature.doc: Softmax temperature applied both during on-policy generation and inside the JSD loss. Larger values produce softer targets. Default ``0.9``.
temperature.help: Generation temperature as well as the softmax temperature used when computing the GKD loss.

trainer_prefix.help: Default prefix used for checkpoints and logs.

epsilon.help: Lower clipping offset for token importance ratios (ratio >= 1 - epsilon).

epsilon_high.doc: Upper clip offset on token ratios (``1 + epsilon_high``). Default ``0.4``.
epsilon_high.help: Upper clipping offset for token importance ratios (ratio <= 1 + epsilon_high).

loss_type.help: Loss variant to use. GMPO uses the geometric-mean 'gmpo' surrogate by default.

completion_chunk_size.help: Chunk size for completion-loss computation. Set to `None` to disable chunked completion loss; `0` is accepted for backward compatibility.

decouple_reward_normalization.doc: GDPO (arXiv:2601.05242) switch. When ``True`` each reward function is normalised within its prompt group before the weighted sum, and the summed reward is then normalised over the batch. This forces ``multi_objective_aggregation="normalize_then_sum"``; after ``__post_init__`` the flag mirrors that setting.
decouple_reward_normalization.help: GDPO: normalize each reward function within its prompt group before the weighted sum, then batch-normalize the summed reward. Forces multi_objective_aggregation='normalize_then_sum'.

delta.help: Optional two-sided clipping bound. If set, importance weights are additionally clipped to `delta`.

disable_dropout.help: Whether to disable dropout in the policy, reference, and reward models.

discard_unscorable_groups.help: What a None reward (unscorable sample: judge or infra failure) does to its prompt group. None (default): per-function opt-in -- the whole group is dropped from the update (zero advantages, tokens and sequences excluded from every loss normaliser) only when the None comes from a reward function whose `discard_unscorable` attribute is True; a None from any other function becomes NaN and is skipped by the nan-aware reward statistics. True: a None from any function drops the group. False: never drop; every None uses the nan-aware aggregation.

dynamic_sampling.doc: DAPO dynamic sampling (arXiv:2503.14476). When ``True``, training batches whose prompt groups have zero reward variance are re-sampled; groups that stay uninformative after ``dynamic_sampling_max_attempts`` are removed from the loss by zeroing their completion mask. Requires ``num_generations >= 2``.
dynamic_sampling.help: DAPO dynamic sampling: re-sample training batches whose prompt groups have zero reward variance.

dynamic_sampling_max_attempts.doc: Total rollout attempts per training batch (the first rollout included).
dynamic_sampling_max_attempts.help: Total rollout attempts per training batch when dynamic_sampling=True.

environment_factory.help: Optional factory that creates an agentic environment for each generated completion. When set, GRPO steps the environment with the generated completion and exposes the environment feedback to reward functions.

epsilon.doc: Lower (and default upper) clipping bound for importance-sampling weights, mirroring PPO.
epsilon.help: Lower clipping bound for importance sampling weights.

epsilon_high.doc: Optional asymmetric upper clip; falls back to ``epsilon`` when ``None``.
epsilon_high.help: Upper clipping bound for importance sampling weights. If None, defaults to `epsilon`.

esurge_importance_sampling_cap.doc: Upper ratio bound (``beta``) for eSurge importance-sampling correction.
esurge_importance_sampling_cap.help: Upper ratio bound for eSurge importance-sampling correction.

esurge_importance_sampling_cap_low.doc: Optional lower ratio bound (``alpha``) for IcePop modes. When ``None``, defaults to ``1.0 / esurge_importance_sampling_cap`` (symmetric ``[1/beta, beta]``).
esurge_importance_sampling_cap_low.help: Optional lower ratio bound for IcePop importance-sampling modes. When None, defaults to 1.0 / esurge_importance_sampling_cap.

esurge_importance_sampling_correction.doc: When ``True``, apply importance-sampling correction between learner and eSurge rollout log-probabilities.

esurge_importance_sampling_mode.doc: Granularity and masking mode for rollout-to-learner mismatch correction. One of ``"token_truncate"``, ``"token_mask"``, ``"token_icepop"``, ``"token_log_mask"``, ``"sequence_truncate"``, ``"sequence_mask"``, ``"sequence_icepop"``, or ``"sequence_log_mask"``. ``"token_icepop"`` implements IcePop's double-sided token mask outside ``[cap_low, cap]``; ``"sequence_icepop"`` is a sequence-level extension of the same band mask. The ``*_log_mask`` modes (Kimi K2.5, arXiv:2602.02276) drop tokens/sequences with ``|log ratio| > log(cap)`` and keep the rest with weight ``1`` (no ratio re-weighting); the sequence variant uses the summed token log ratio and both require ``cap > 1``.
esurge_importance_sampling_mode.help: eSurge importance-sampling mode. One of 'token_truncate', 'token_mask', 'token_icepop', 'token_log_mask', 'sequence_truncate', 'sequence_mask', 'sequence_icepop', or 'sequence_log_mask'.

generation_batch_size.help: Effective batch size used for generation. Mutually exclusive with `steps_per_generation`; when set, EasyDeL derives `steps_per_generation = generation_batch_size // total_batch_size`.

importance_sampling_level.help: Importance sampling applied per 'token', aggregated per 'sequence', or GSPO-token 'sequence_token'.

kl_estimator.doc: Per-token estimator of ``KL(pi || pi_ref)`` used for the ``beta`` penalty: ``"k1"`` (``log r``), ``"k2"`` (``0.5 * (log r)^2``), ``"k3"`` (``1/r - 1 + log r``, default), or ``"l2"`` (``(log r)^2``), with ``r = pi / pi_ref``.
kl_estimator.help: Per-token estimator of KL(pi || pi_ref) used by the beta penalty: 'k1' (log r), 'k2' (0.5 * (log r)^2), 'k3' (1/r - 1 + log r), or 'l2' ((log r)^2), with r = pi / pi_ref.

log_unique_prompts.help: When logging completions, keep only the first completion for each unique prompt.

logprob_vocab_chunk_size.help: Vocabulary chunk size used when computing per-token log probabilities and entropies. Set to `None` to disable chunking.

loss_type.doc: One of ``"grpo"``, ``"bnpo"``, ``"dr_grpo"``, ``"dapo"``, ``"cispo"``, ``"sapo"``, ``"luspo"``, ``"vespo"``, ``"gmpo"``. mask_truncated_completions.help: If True, drop completions that do not terminate with EOS from the loss calculation.

max_completion_length.help: The maximum length of the completion.

max_prompt_length.help: The maximum length of the prompt.

max_tool_calls_per_step.help: Maximum number of tool calls executed during one environment step.

multi_objective_aggregation.help: Multi-reward aggregation strategy. 'sum_then_normalize' first sums weighted reward functions and then normalizes. 'normalize_then_sum' normalizes each reward function within prompt groups before weighted summation and batch-level advantage normalization.

num_completions_to_print.doc: Optional cap on the number of completion rows emitted by ``log_completions``.
num_completions_to_print.help: Maximum number of completion rows to print when log_completions=True.

num_generations.help: Alias for num_return_sequences to keep parity with TRL's interface.

num_return_sequences.help: The number of sequences to return for each input prompt. Used during sampling to generate multiple completions per prompt.

off_policy_mask_threshold.doc: Optional sequence-level forward-KL threshold for dropping negative-advantage off-policy samples from the policy objective.
off_policy_mask_threshold.help: Optional off-policy sequence mask threshold. Negative-advantage samples with mean forward KL above this value are removed from the policy objective.

off_policy_min_acceptance.help: Optional minimum accepted/eligible sequence fraction; below it the step leaves parameters and optimizer state unchanged. Requires esurge_importance_sampling_correction=True.

pad_to_multiple_of.doc: If set, prompt batches are padded to a multiple of this value while still truncating prompt content to ``max_prompt_length``.
pad_to_multiple_of.help: If set, GRPO prompt batches are padded to a multiple of this value.

prefix_shared_forward.help: Run the policy loss forward with prompts once per group: a capture pass over the prompts records each layer's key/value states and a fork pass scores the completions against the gathered prefix. Dense full-attention models, and hybrid qwen3_next models (full attention plus gated-delta linear_attention layers, whose end-of-prompt conv window and recurrent state are captured instead; prompt and completion lengths must be >= 2), with attn_mechanism 'vanilla', 'sdpa', 'flash_attn2' or 'blocksparse' only (flash_attn2 at the model's default matmul precision is bf16-pass accurate, about 6e-3, on TPU; the TPU Pallas gated-delta kernel's default precision puts qwen3_next log-probs about 2.6e-4 from the repeated-prompt forward). Other hybrid/recurrent families (KDA, MLA, Mamba) are rejected; incompatible with completion_chunk_size, top_entropy_quantile < 1 and mpmd_scheduler. With 'vanilla'/'sdpa' the completions attend the shared prefix without a per-completion copy (exact log-sum-exp merge); on TPU (697M dense model, G=8) it beat the default forward at every measured prompt/completion ratio, e.g. 0.119 s vs 0.316 s per step at P=1024/C=256 and 0.325 s vs 0.378 s at P=512/C=2048. 'flash_attn2'/'blocksparse' still copy the prefix per completion and only pay off when prompts are at least as long as completions.

bucket_datasets.help: Optional list of datasets/ShardedDataSource, one per bucket in `buckets`, used to build each bucket's dataloader. Length must match `buckets`. When None and `buckets` is set, all buckets fall back to the primary `dataset_train`.

bucket_rule.help: easydel.trainers.buckets.BucketRule selecting the active bucket index per optimizer step (e.g. ModBucketRule(mod=5, on_bucket=0, off_bucket=1) for two buckets, or PatternBucketRule(pattern=[0, 0, 1, 1, 2]) for an arbitrary repeating N-way ratio). Required when `buckets` is set; ignored otherwise. Must be serializable (CallableBucketRule is not — to_dict runs on every checkpoint save).

buckets.help: Optional list of easydel.trainers.buckets.TrainingBucket configs. When set together with `bucket_rule`, the trainer builds one compiled step function and one dataloader per bucket and selects which to use each step via `bucket_rule.select(step)`. Each bucket is a model-config variant (e.g. attn_mechanism override) plus its own max_length/dataloader; all buckets share one parameter/optimizer tree. None (default) disables bucketing and the trainer behaves exactly as before.

clip_grad.help: The value at which to clip the gradients.

custom_scheduler.help: A custom scheduler function that takes the current step as input.

data_lane_local_batch.help: When True on the grain data lanes (`parquetra_train_datasets` / `arrayrecord_train_*`), each batch-shard host group loads and collates only its own local batch rows instead of the full global batch, and `place_batch` lifts each group's local batch into the global sharded array. Requires a `data_collator` sized to the local group batch (see `data_lanes.resolve_lane_batch_size`). Default False preserves the global-batch contract.

dataloader_fast_forward_on_resume.help: Fast-forward/seek the train dataloader by the resumed global step at the start of training. Disable for streaming pack-on-the-fly sources where no cheap seek exists and a sequential skip would re-render/re-pack the entire consumed prefix; the stream then restarts from batch 0 (same behavior training buckets document on resume) while the optimizer/scheduler/step state still resumes correctly.

dataloader_num_workers.help: The number of workers to use for the dataloader.

dataloader_pin_memory.help: Whether to pin memory for the dataloader.

dataloader_prefetch.help: Whether to overlap trainer-level batch fetching and collation with the current compiled train step using background host workers. JAX preprocessing and execution remain on the main training thread.

dataloader_prefetch_buffer_size.help: Maximum collated batches queued ahead by the batch prefetcher (per bucket when training buckets are enabled). Defaults to `dataloader_prefetch_workers`. Each queued batch holds one full global batch in host memory.

dataloader_prefetch_workers.help: Parallel host producer threads for the trainer-level batch prefetcher (requires `dataloader_prefetch`). Fetching from the dataloader iterator stays serialized so the stream order is deterministic; collation fans out across workers. Raise this when producing one batch (fetch + collate) takes longer than the device step — e.g. large global batches or heavy collators. The data collator must be thread-safe when set > 1.

do_eval.help: Whether to run evaluation during training.

do_last_save.help: Whether to save the model at the end of training.

esurge_async_scheduling.help: Enable/disable eSurge async scheduler token sampling. None keeps eSurge default behavior.

esurge_data_parallelism_axis.help: Mesh axis name used by eSurge as the data-parallel KV-page axis (e.g. 'dp').

esurge_enable_prefix_caching.help: Enable/disable eSurge prefix caching. None keeps engine default behavior.

esurge_hbm_utilization.help: HBM utilization target (0.0-1.0) for eSurge KV-cache sizing. Sizing priority: (1) esurge_max_cache_tokens if set -> cap the pool to that many tokens; (2) else this hbm_utilization if set -> size the pool from that HBM fraction; (3) else (both None, default) -> the trainer auto-computes a budget from the generation batch (max_length x total_batch_size x num_generations) so it doesn't over-allocate a huge pool from a blanket HBM fraction against the model's full context window.

esurge_max_cache_tokens.help: Hard ceiling on the total eSurge KV-cache token capacity. When set, the page pool is sized to min(esurge_hbm_utilization-derived, this), so a generous hbm_utilization can't allocate (e.g.) a 1M-token cache when the run only needs 64k. When None AND esurge_hbm_utilization is also None (both default), the trainer auto-computes the budget as max_length x total_batch_size x num_generations.

esurge_max_num_batched_tokens.help: Maximum number of tokens to batch together for eSurge generation. None uses eSurge default.

esurge_max_num_seq_buckets.help: Optional explicit sequence-capacity buckets for eSurge runner compilation.

esurge_max_num_seqs.help: Maximum number of concurrent sequences for eSurge batch processing. None uses eSurge default.

esurge_min_input_pad.help: Minimum input padding for eSurge sequences. None uses eSurge default.

esurge_overlap_execution.help: Enable/disable eSurge double-buffered execution overlap. None keeps eSurge default behavior.

esurge_page_size.help: Page size for eSurge KV cache management. None uses eSurge default.

esurge_runner_verbose.help: Enable verbose eSurge runner performance logs (including `[perf]` lines).

esurge_silent_mode.help: Silence eSurge info logs (engine start/stop/resume, cache events).

esurge_use_tqdm.help: Whether to use tqdm progress bars for eSurge generations.

eval_batch_size.help: The batch size to use for evaluation.

eval_config_overrides.help: Model-config overrides applied ONLY to the evaluation forward, e.g. {'attn_mechanism': 'vanilla'} to evaluate on the reference attention kernel while training on a sparse one. Like training buckets, this builds a separate structure-preserving graphdef via lazy_init and swaps it into the state for the compiled eval step; parameter/optimizer buffers are shared, never copied, and never mutated by evaluation. Only structure-preserving keys are allowed. None (default) evaluates with the training config.

extra_optimizer_kwargs.help: Additional keyword arguments to pass to the optimizer.

eyvan_report_progress.help: Forward rank-0 scalar step progress (`step`, `total`, finite scalar metrics) to `eyvan.report_progress(...)`. Acts as a fast no-op when `EYVAN_PROGRESS_URL` is absent.

eyvan_track_flush_interval_s.help: Background flush interval in seconds for `eyvan.track.start(...)`.

eyvan_track_group.help: Optional sweep or experiment group name for Eyvan tracking.

eyvan_track_name.help: Human-readable run name for Eyvan tracking. Falls back to `wandb_name` or a cached W&B-style auto-generated name (e.g. `qwen3-grpo-amber-falcon-42`).

eyvan_track_project.help: Local Eyvan tracking project slug (`[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}`) used when no explicit store URI is configured. Defaults from `EasyDeL-{trainer_prefix}` or `easydel`.

eyvan_track_tags.help: Optional list of tags for Eyvan tracking; merged with auto-detected framework, trainer, RL/feature, model, and hardware tags, deduplicated, and clamped to Eyvan limits.

eyvan_track_uri.help: Explicit Eyvan tracking store URI (`gs://...`, `file://...`, or local directory). When omitted, respects `EYVAN_TRACKING_URI`, then queries `eyvan.storage.resolve_default_tracking_uri` (configured default monitoring bucket), and finally falls back to `~/.eyvan/tracking/default/<project>`.

first_rollout_timeout.help: Timeout in seconds for the very first async rollout (covers cold XLA compile).

force_step_start_point.help: Force `step_start_point` onto a loaded nonzero state as well. When enabled, the trainer overwrites both `state.step` and optimizer/scheduler count leaves even if the incoming state was loaded manually rather than resumed through the trainer's auto-resume path.

frozen_parameters.help: A regex pattern of parameters to freeze (not train).

generation_config_overrides.help: Attribute overrides applied to the copied generation config for previews.

generation_dataset_prompt_field.help: Dataset field to treat as prompt text when sampling from the training set.

generation_do_sample.help: Whether to enable sampling when generating previews (auto-inferred when None).

generation_extra_kwargs.help: Additional kwargs forwarded to `model.generate` for previews.

generation_frequency_penalty.help: Default frequency penalty used for preview generations.

generation_interval.help: Run preview generation every X training steps (disabled when None).

generation_log_to_wandb.help: Whether to log preview generations to WandB when available.

generation_max_new_tokens.help: Maximum number of newly generated tokens for previews.

generation_num_prompts.help: Number of prompts to use per preview generation call.

generation_num_return_sequences.help: Number of completions to sample per prompt for preview generations.

generation_presence_penalty.help: Default presence penalty used for preview generations.

generation_preview_print.help: Whether to print preview generations to Terminal.

generation_prompts.help: Static prompts (text or tokenized dicts) to sample during preview generation.

generation_repetition_penalty.help: Default repetition penalty used for preview generations.

generation_seed.help: Seed for preview prompt sampling (None uses a random seed).

generation_shard_inputs.help: Whether generation previews should reuse the model's sharding plan.

generation_temperature.help: Default sampling temperature for preview generations.

generation_top_k.help: Default top-k sampling threshold used for preview generations.

generation_top_p.help: Default nucleus sampling threshold used for preview generations.

generation_use_train_prompts.help: When True, sample additional prompts from the training dataset for previews.

gradient_accumulation_mode.help: 'scan' (default): the microbatch loop is a lax.scan inside the compiled step. 'execution': each microbatch is its own grad-program execution into a donated fp32 accumulator, followed by one apply-program execution, so fwd/bwd and optimizer temporaries do not stack. Only trainers whose step supports it (distillation) accept 'execution'.

gradient_accumulation_steps.help: The number of steps to accumulate gradients over.

grain_shard_count.help: sharding count to be used for grain dataloaders in both train and eval steps (lanes: None = number of batch-shard host groups, see grain_shard_index).

grain_shard_index.help: sharding index to be used for grain dataloaders in both train and eval steps. For the parquetra / ArrayRecord lanes, None groups hosts by the batch shards their devices hold (hosts that share a shard read the same rows); set both index and count to override.

heartbeat_stale_after_s.help: Timeout in seconds before an async rollout worker is treated as stalled.

host_phase_log_path.help: Optional per-host timing log: a local append-only JSONL file, or a cloud prefix containing immutable per-step JSONL chunks.

ids_to_pop_from_dataset.help: A list of dataset columns to remove before training.

init_tx.help: Whether to initialize the training state.

is_fine_tuning.help: Whether the training is a fine-tuning run.

learning_rate_end.help: The final learning rate for linear decay schedulers.

lmhead_chunksize.help: Optional token chunk size for LM-head projection during training/inference.

log_all_workers.help: Whether to log metrics from all workers in a distributed setup.

log_training_generations_to_wandb.help: Whether to log rollout/training generations to WandB when available.

low_mem_usage.help: Whether to try to minimize memory usage.

max_inflight_tasks.help: Maximum number of queued/inflight async rollout tasks when `async_mode=True`.

max_staleness.help: Maximum allowed optimizer-step lag between rollout generation and consumption.

max_training_steps.help: The maximum number of training steps.

merge_lora_before_save.help: When True, regular and final trainer checkpoints save a merged LoRA export at the checkpoint root. Merged LoRA checkpoints also keep an unmerged LoRA copy under `_resume_model` so `EasyDeLState.load_state()` can resume the original training graph with or without optimizer state.

merge_lora_before_tpu_preemption_save.help: Whether TPU preemption checkpoints should also export merged LoRA weights. Defaults to False so emergency saves stay on the faster resume-focused path.

metrics_to_show_in_rich_pbar.help: Metrics to display in the rich progress bar.

mpmd_scheduler.help: Optional MPMD pipeline schedule (``spx.runtime.schedules.Schedule`` instance, e.g. ``Std1F1B(microbatches=N)`` / ``GPipe(microbatches=N)``). Forwarded to ``spx.jit(schedule=...)`` when the model mesh is MPMD. If None, the trainer step runs as a forward-only marker-cluster MPMD program (no microbatch interleaving / 1F1B). Ignored on SPMD meshes.

no_weight_decay_patterns.help: Optional list of regex/substring parameter path patterns excluded from weight decay (e.g. ['loop_gates', 'loop_iter_embeddings']).

offload_dataset.help: Whether to offload the dataset to CPU or disk.

offload_device_index.help: The device index to offload the dataset to.

offload_device_type.help: The device type to offload the dataset to (cpu or disk).

param_lr_multipliers.help: Optional mapping of regex/substring parameter path patterns to learning-rate multipliers (e.g. {'loop_gates': 10.0, 'loop_iter_embeddings': 10.0}). Applied statelessly at the end of the optimizer chain (zero extra optimizer state).

parquet_metadata_cache_dir.help: Root (local or gs://) for durable parquet footer / row-group index sidecars used by the parquetra lanes; restarts then skip the footer scan. Only process 0 writes remote sidecars.

parquetra_assistant_only.help: Per-dataset assistant-only loss for the parquetra lanes, keyed like `parquetra_train_datasets` (partial dicts inherit `assistant_only_loss`; unknown keys raise).

parquetra_fast_tokenizer.help: Optional `module:attr` import path of a factory `factory(hf_tokenizer) -> encode` where `encode(text) -> list[int]` reproduces `hf_tokenizer(text, add_special_tokens=False)`. Rows are rendered with the chat template and encoded by it; the first `parquetra_fast_tokenizer_verify_rows` rows of every worker are checked against the full transform and any divergence raises. Only valid without prompt masking.

parquetra_fast_tokenizer_verify_rows.help: Rows per worker the fast tokenizer must reproduce exactly before it runs unchecked.

parquetra_mixture_weights.help: Weights `{name: weight}` for `parquetra_train_datasets`; None = row-count proportional.

parquetra_mp_worker_cpu_only.help: Configure each spawned parquetra worker process for CPU-only JAX before it unpickles the pipeline (drops TPU_/MEGASCALE_/CLOUD_TPU_ variables and sets JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu in the CHILD only), so a worker cannot try to claim accelerators held by the trainer. The trainer's environment is untouched.

parquetra_mp_workers.help: grain mp_prefetch worker processes for the parquetra lanes (0 = thread prefetch only). Order is preserved, so seeked resume is unchanged.

parquetra_pack_embed_cap.help: Max image-embed rows per packed window-set (sum of `embed_n_tok`); 0 = uncapped.

parquetra_pack_misfit_patience.help: The packer closes a window-set after this many rows failed to fit; they carry to the next set. Higher = denser windows, more host work per set.

parquetra_pack_seq_len.help: When > 0 the parquetra lane packs: rows are pulled from the shuffled, per-host-sharded, weight-mixed row stream until `total_batch_size` windows of this length are full (first fit, whole documents, never truncated). The data_collator receives one window-set per call as a flat row list in placement order. Resume is seed-shifted: step n starts the stream a fresh build at step_start_point=n would produce, without materializing skipped batches. Requires `max_training_steps`.

parquetra_tokenizer_id.help: Tokenizer id for in-loop tokenization when the trainer has no processing_class.

parquetra_train_datasets.help: Per-dataset parquet globs `{name: glob}` for the grain random-access parquet lane: row-level global shuffle over raw parquet, tokenized in the loader with the trainer's preprocess transform. Mutually exclusive with the ArrayRecord lane. Requires an explicit `data_collator`.

per_epoch_evaluation_steps.help: The maximum number of evaluation step per each epoch.

per_epoch_training_steps.help: The maximum number of training step per each epoch.

performance_mode.help: Whether to enable performance mode (e.g., XLA compilation).

pose.help: PoSE (positional skip-wise) position_ids augmentation; disabled by default.

process_encoder.help: Run a VLM vision tower out of band (frozen, vision-bearing rows only) and hand precomputed patch embeddings to the train step; disabled by default.

process_zero_is_admin.help: Whether the process with rank 0 is the admin process.

profiler_duration_ms.help: Bound the JAX profiler collection window to this many milliseconds after the trace starts. Large programs (e.g. chunked-scan layers) emit millions of device op events per step and can overflow the profiler's 2GB XSpace protobuf cap when tracing whole steps; a bounded time slice keeps the trace valid. None traces until `profiler_stop_step`/end of training.

profiler_enable_hlo_proto.help: Override ProfileOptions.enable_hlo_proto (embedding compiled HLO protos in the trace). Set False to shrink traces for very large programs. None keeps the library default.

profiler_host_tracer_level.help: Optional `jax.profiler.ProfileOptions().host_tracer_level` override (1-4). Higher values capture more host-side detail at the cost of more overhead. Only used when `profiler_path` is set.

profiler_include_compile.help: Whether to start the JAX profiler before the first training step. This captures the initial compile/HLO data needed by xprof op views, at the cost of including compile time in the trace.

profiler_log_all_workers.help: Whether all distributed workers should record JAX profiler traces. This is separate from `log_all_workers` so profiling TPU workers does not enable per-worker metrics, W&B, progress bars, or checkpoint logging.

profiler_path.help: Optional output directory for the JAX profiler trace. When set, the trainer calls `jax.profiler.start_trace(profiler_path)` immediately after the first training step completes (so the trace excludes the initial JIT-compile of step 1) and `jax.profiler.stop_trace()` when training finishes. Only rank 0 records the trace unless `profiler_log_all_workers` is True. Set to None to disable profiling.

profiler_python_tracer_level.help: Optional `jax.profiler.ProfileOptions().python_tracer_level` override for Python function-level profiling. Only used when `profiler_path` is set.

profiler_stop_step.help: Stop the JAX profiler trace once the global step reaches this value, so a production run can capture a bounded few-step trace instead of tracing to the end of training. The trace starts after step 1 (see `profiler_path`); e.g. profiler_stop_step=6 captures steps 2-6. None traces until training finishes.

progress_bar_type.help: The type of progress bar to use.

quantization_bits.help: Quantization bit-width for QAT/STE quantizers. For `affine`, supported bits are 2..8. For fixed-width formats (`nf4`, `mxfp4`, `nvfp4`, `mxfp8`, `nvfp8`), when provided it must match the format width.

quantization_group_size.help: Quantization group size for group-wise quantizers (e.g. NF4/AFFINE/MXFP*/NVFP*). If None, the default group size for the selected quantization mode is used.

quantization_mode.help: Quantization mode for quantization-aware training (QAT). Supported values: {STE_QAT_QUANTIZATION_MODES_DOC}. When set (or when a straight-through callable is provided), trainers can apply a straight-through estimator (STE) transform to `state.graphstate` for the forward pass without permanently modifying the stored parameters.

queue_maxsize.help: Optional cap on buffered async rollout tasks (0 uses `max_inflight_tasks`).

randomized_yarn.help: Randomized YaRN position_ids augmentation (sorted random positions under a length curriculum); disabled by default and mutually exclusive with `pose`.

remove_ckpt_after_load.help: Whether to remove the checkpoint after loading it.

remove_unused_columns.help: Whether to remove unused columns from the dataset.

report_metrics.help: Whether to report metrics to a logger.

request_timeout.help: Timeout in seconds waiting for a background async rollout task.

resume_if_possible.help: Automatically resume from the latest checkpoint if available.

save_directory.help: The directory to save checkpoints to.

save_interval_minutes.help: Interval Minutes to save the checkpoint for state.

save_optimizer_state.help: Whether to save the optimizer state along with the model.

save_steps.help: Save a checkpoint every X steps.

save_total_limit.help: Maximum number of permanent checkpoints to keep. Older checkpoints are deleted. Note: Temporary checkpoints (time-based) are managed separately by Checkpointer.

save_tpu_preemption_checkpoints.help: Whether to force-save a standard EasyDeL checkpoint when JAX's TPU preemption sync service reaches a safe save step.

sequence_packing.help: Pack multiple short sequences into fixed-length blocks of `max_length` tokens to cut padding waste. Documents stay isolated (block-diagonal attention + per-document position reset; linear-attention/SSM state is reset at boundaries where supported). Honored by single-stream supervised/offline trainers such as SFT, distillation, and GOLD; rollout, pairwise-preference, reward, and embedding trainers warn and ignore it.

shuffle_seed_train.help: seed used for trainer dataloader shuffle.

shuffle_train_dataset.help: Whether to shuffle the training dataset.

sparse_module_type.help: The type of sparse module to use.

state_apply_fn_kwarguments_to_model.help: Keyword arguments to pass to the state apply function.

step_partition_spec.help: The partition specification for the training step.

step_start_point.help: The step to start training from (for resuming).

straight_through_emulator.help: Callable that maps a graphstate pytree -> new graphstate pytree for the forward pass. If None, and quantization is enabled, trainers can default to applying `jax.tree_util.tree_map(tensor_straight_through, graphstate)`.

tensor_straight_through.help: Per-tensor straight-through transform used for QAT (e.g. tensor -> quantize(mode) -> dequantize with identity gradients). If `straight_through_emulator` is not provided, this callable can be mapped over `state.graphstate` via `jax.tree_util.tree_map`.

track_memory.help: Whether to track memory usage. If a float, it sets the memory tracking interval in seconds.

train_on_inputs.help: Whether to train on the input data.

trainable_selector.help: Selector used when converting models to EasyDeLState. Use 'parameters' for base weights, 'lora' for adapter-only training, or a tuple like ('parameters', 'lora') in Python code for combined training.

tx_mu_dtype.help: The dtype to use for the `tx.mu` variable.

use_data_collator.help: Whether to use a data collator.

use_eyvan_track.help: Whether to log experiment metrics to Eyvan (`eyvan.track`). `None` (default) auto-enables whenever `eyvan` is installed and `performance_mode=False` (and not suppressed by test isolation via `set_eyvan_auto_track_enabled(False)`); `True` forces on; `False` disables completely. Disabled automatically when `performance_mode=True`.

use_grain.help: Whether to use grain instead of `tensorflow-datasets`.

use_wandb.help: Whether to use Weights & Biases for logging.

warmup_steps.help: The number of warmup steps for the learning rate scheduler.

watchers.help: List of LogWatcher instances that define custom per-parameter metrics to log at independent intervals during training.

weight_distribution_log_steps.help: log weight distribution every X steps.

weight_distribution_pattern.help: The pattern to use to extract weight distribution.

weight_sync_steps.help: Optimizer steps between rollout policy snapshot refreshes when `async_mode=True`.

xla_compiler_options.help: Per-compile XLA compiler option overrides forwarded to the train-step jit (e.g. {'xla_tpu_enable_latency_hiding_scheduler': 'true'}). Safer than env XLA_FLAGS: unknown options raise a catchable error at compile instead of crashing workers at libtpu load. Applies to the marker-based jit path (including bucketed steps); the scheduled MPMD path (mpmd_scheduler with a registered scheduled-loss adapter) does not forward it.

zero_supervision_abort_fraction.help: Raise when more than this fraction of a batch's documents end with zero supervised tokens while per-dataset assistant-only masking is active (a misconfiguration signal). None disables it.

zero_supervision_dump_limit.help: Zero-supervision documents logged (once per process) when the report threshold fires.

zero_supervision_report_fraction.help: Warn when more than this fraction of a batch's documents end with zero supervised tokens under assistant-only masking. None disables the warning; the census metrics are always reported.

TrainingArguments.summary: Comprehensive configuration class for training and evaluation.

gae_lambda_critic.help: Decoupled GAE lambda for value targets. VAPO uses 1.0.

length_adaptive_gae.doc: Use the length-adaptive policy lambda. Default ``True``.
length_adaptive_gae.help: Use the per-trajectory policy lambda clip(1 - 1 / (alpha * length), 0, 1).

positive_nll_coef.help: Weight of the NLL auxiliary loss on positive (score > threshold) completions.

token_level_loss.help: Normalize the policy loss by the total completion-token count of the rollout batch.

trainer_prefix.doc: Prefix for logs and checkpoints. Default ``"VAPO"``.
trainer_prefix.help: Default prefix name for trainer outputs/checkpoints.

alpha.doc: Optimistic exploration weight on ``+sum_t log pi_theta(y^ref_t | prompt, y^ref_<t)``. Default is the single-element list ``[1e-5]``, which the ``__post_init__`` collapses to the scalar ``1e-5``. Sequence form enables epoch-wise scheduling.
alpha.help: Weight of the optimistic exploratory term (+alpha * log pi_theta(y_ref | x)) discouraging collapse onto reference completions. Supports epoch-wise scheduling.

beta.doc: KL-penalty weight against the reference policy. Pass a scalar for a constant schedule or a sequence for an epoch-wise schedule (final value is reused when the schedule is exhausted).
beta.help: Prospect-theoretic scaling for the KL penalty. A list enables epoch-wise scheduling; the final value is reused when the schedule is exhausted.

loss_type.doc: Selects the DPO surrogate. ``"sigmoid"`` (default) uses the Bradley-Terry log-sigmoid loss; ``"ipo"`` uses the squared-margin Identity Preference Optimization variant.
loss_type.help: Choice of DPO loss. Matches the TRL implementation options.

missing_eos_penalty.doc: Optional penalty subtracted from the reward of completions that do not emit an EOS token before the length cap; encourages well-formed sequences. ``None`` disables the penalty.
missing_eos_penalty.help: Optional penalty subtracted from the reward when a completion does not emit an EOS token. Encourages shorter generations when set.

trainer_prefix.doc: Prefix used when naming logs / checkpoints / W&B runs. Default: ``"XPO"``.
